history.q: What assets are acceptable as collateral?
history.a:
[S1] “Acceptable Collateral”
 means
any items of Collateral and Third Party Pledgor Collateral that the Bank determines in its sole discretion from time to time are eligible
to secure the Obligations and are satisfactorily pledged hereunder or under any Third Party Pledge Agreement; 
[***]
 (a) (i)
